call-to-missing-route.message: CatalogClient.release sends POST /products/:param/release to catalog-api, which serves no such route
call-to-missing-route.evidence: every route of the service it is sent to was read: no address left partly unread, no catch-all
call-to-missing-route.fix: the nearest route: POST /products/:param/publish (one segment off: release for publish)

field-never-sent.message: `name` of the body of POST /products is read by ProductsController.create and not sent by storefront's request
field-never-sent.evidence: every sender on the crossing and every reader of it was read
field-never-sent.fix: likely renamed: productName is sent, name is read

field-never-sent.message: `productTitle` is read by CatalogEventsService.onCatalogEvent on catalog_events (PRODUCT_CREATED) and sent by none of its publishers
field-never-sent.evidence: every sender on the crossing and every reader of it was read
field-never-sent.fix: likely renamed: title is sent, productTitle is read

type-never-published.message: CatalogEventsService.onCatalogEvent handles LISTING_CANCELED on catalog_events, which nothing publishes; its 2 publish(es) send LISTING_CANCELLED, PRODUCT_CREATED
type-never-published.evidence: every publish on catalog_events says the type it sends
type-never-published.fix: likely renamed: LISTING_CANCELLED is published, LISTING_CANCELED is handled

unguarded-among-guarded.message: DELETE /products/:param has no guard in front of it and reaches products, while the 2 other writes of ProductsController have StaffGuard in front.
unguarded-among-guarded.evidence: every other write of its router is guarded and the routes of src/products/products.controller.ts were read whole; no public marker is on it

annotation-to-missing-route.message: @CallsService points at GET /products/:id/reviews, which catalog-api does not serve
annotation-to-missing-route.evidence: every route of the service the annotation names was read: no address left partly unread, no catch-all
annotation-to-missing-route.fix: the nearest route: GET /products/:param (one segment off: reviews added)

message-type-unselected.message: no code that runs selects LISTING_CANCELLED on catalog_events: 1 consumer chooses other types (CatalogEventsService.onCatalogEvent)

unguarded.message: GET /stock/:param has no guard in front of it and reaches products.

call-to-missing-route.why: some routes of legacy-api were not read (route-path-dynamic)

type-never-published.why: 1 publish(es) on stock_events send a type not read

config-not-set.why: no deployment file of storefront was read: its settings may be set where the reading does not look
